issue_context.title: Make @@tidb_constraint_check_in_place session variable work for unique index in the sysbench `oltp_update_index` workload
issue_context.body:
## Description

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1420062/96205025-3b57fd80-0f98-11eb-9334-3fb468444db9.png)

From the trace result, we can see that update the unique index needs to `getSnapshot` and visit TiKV (`SendReqCtx`) to ensure the new KV entry does not exist.

It should be possible to make this check lazy, just make an assumption the new value does not exist and delay the check to 2PC commit.

This is exactly what `@@tidb_constraint_check_in_place` do, so this task is to verify it could work, fix the code if it's broken.
